entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Omer Pasha Mosque was built by Ketendji Omer Pasha in 1602. It is located in Elmalı, Antalya Province, Turkey. The mosque, built entirely of cut stone, has a single dome. It reflects the classical Ottoman architecture. The mosque was built on a sloping area with a square plan. The mosque is the biggest Ottoman mosque in the Antalya area.
